title: IDEA-Bench: How Far are Generative Models from Professional Designing?

layout.note: Left half: five colour-bordered example cards in two columns (three at the left, two at the right) with the leaderboard table wedged between the two right-hand cards; right half: a large sunburst with IDEA-Bench in its white centre, five category sectors, subtask groups and about 100 rotated leaf labels around the rim. The card border colours repeat the sector colours.

lesson: Summarise a benchmark in one composite: give each category a colour, show one example card per category (title with task count, subtask, input and output thumbnails, dashed prompt), a ranked leaderboard, and a sunburst whose sectors reuse the card colours and carry every subtask name.
